items.verify:
- e卡 Cash → Add Funds → Bank｜ether.fi Help Center（2026-10-18 查阅）：Open Cash → Add Funds → Bank → USD；可选 ACH / Fedwire，复制显示的银行账户信息后从本行发起同币种转账 https://help.ether.fi/en/articles/584583-fedwire-and-ach-transfers-usd
- MoonPay 稳定币卡基础设施｜MoonPay Newsroom（2025-05-15 / 2026-05-01）：与 Mastercard 合作推出绑定稳定币余额的品牌卡；MoonAgents Card 经 Monavate 发行虚拟 Mastercard https://www.moonpay.com/newsroom/mastercard-stablecoin-payments https://www.moonpay.com/newsroom/moonagents-card
- Banking Circle 虚拟 IBAN / 稳定币结算｜Banking Circle（2026-10-18 查阅）：向 PSP/机构提供虚拟 IBAN 与多币种账户；获 CSSF CASP 后推出 fiat↔stablecoin 结算（USDC 等） https://www.bankingcircle.com/accounts/ https://www.bankingcircle.com/banking-circle-introduces-stablecoin-settlement-services/
- Lead Bank 稳定币卡｜Lead Bank（2026-10-18 查阅）：提供 stablecoin-backed Visa/Mastercard 发卡与网络结算；Cardefi 列出其为 Kraken、Phantom 等发卡方之一 https://www.lead.bank/products/stablecoin-backed-cards
- OKX 新加坡地址证明｜OKX Help（2026-10-18 查阅）：POA 须含法定全名与现住址、近 ==3== 个月内签发；接受银行账单/水电账单/租约等；发卡方为 Xfers/StraitsX https://www.okx.com/en-sg/help/how-do-i-submit-my-proof-of-address-poa
